_comment: Supply profiles: today's constants as rows (town-planner appendix B2). Numbers are U judgments copied from internal/task/route.go, gate.go, goal.go and resource/recovery.go; the SME review is card town12. SME review 2026-11-27 (town-profiles-sme.md section 3) applied by card townapply, confidence per row in the notes object. beltSlots: min/target by belt size (largest key not above the hero belt; unknown size or a belt below every key keeps the row min, which the capacity clamp lowers). tierFloor: lowest potion tier that counts, carried to the plan as data. SME review 2026-11-27 confidence per row: andariel beltSlots high, blood_raven mana 4 high, andariel tierFloor 2 (Light) medium, duriel medium, catacombs medium, tristram medium, countess medium. Not applied (need behavior code): antidote and thawing lines, field healing by clvl band. manaNeedAtLeast: the line applies only to a build whose mana need (build profile data) is at least that.
